description: Infiltrate Quantum Dynamics Corporation to identify and stop an insider threat. ENTROPY has recruited an employee to exfiltrate quantum-safe key material for the National Emergency-Services Dispatch Network. You have 4 hours to find the insider, gather evidence, and stop the acquisition before the 999 dispatch network's key-rotation window opens.
title: Insider Trading
learning_objectives: Identify indicators of insider threats through behavioral analysis
Correlate digital evidence (VM flags) with physical evidence (documents, interviews)
Exploit Bludit CMS via brute-force credential recovery and authenticated image-upload remote code execution
Navigate complex moral decisions with lasting consequences
Understand ENTROPY's systematic recruitment and radicalization methodology

challenges: Web Exploitation - authenticated Bludit image-upload RCE
User Access - Torres' exfiltration staging manifest

narrative_summary.act1: Arrive at Quantum Dynamics as SAFETYNET security consultant. Meet CSO Patricia Morgan who briefs you on suspected insider threat. Begin investigation by interviewing employees and gathering access credentials.
narrative_summary.act2: Clone employee badge to access server areas. Exploit Bludit CMS server to extract digital evidence. Discover David Torres' radicalization through ENTROPY's Insider Threat Initiative. Find medical bills revealing wife's cancer as leverage point. The Recruiter calls directly, offering a deal to let her other targets go unwarned.
narrative_summary.act3: Correlate all evidence to identify Torres. Confront him with choices: turn as double agent, arrest with cooperation, arrest without cooperation, combat (which resolves to a post-KO choice), or public exposure. No ending is ranked above another — each carries its own consequences.

key_npcs.name: Patricia Morgan
key_npcs.importance: Mission handler, provides security access and intelligence

key_npcs.name: Kevin Park
key_npcs.importance: Badge cloning target, provides technical intel

key_npcs.name: Dr. Sarah Chen
key_npcs.importance: Research badge access, emotional response to Torres accusation

key_npcs.name: Lisa Park
key_npcs.importance: Optional NPC, humanizes Torres through family context

key_npcs.name: David Torres
key_npcs.importance: Primary antagonist, subject of confrontation with multiple unranked endings

key_npcs.name: The Recruiter
key_npcs.importance: Live phone antagonist, calls once Torres is identified and offers the player a deal

moral_complexity.primary_dilemma: Torres is both perpetrator (knowingly enabled a lethal delay to emergency dispatch) and victim (radicalized through medical debt). He's only 3 months into radicalization - early enough to potentially save. The Recruiter argues the harder case: he made an informed choice, and forty-seven more candidates are already in her pipeline.
moral_complexity.entropy_portrayal: A systematic recruitment methodology run by people who calculate and approve civilian casualties as an acceptable cost. The Recruiter is unapologetic and persuasive, not a cartoon villain.
moral_complexity.player_agency: Multiple ending paths, unranked, with differences in campaign impact, Elena's treatment, and future intelligence gathering
